findings.title: Refactored credential-gating helpers have no offline test
findings.why_it_matters: The PR says behaviour is unchanged, but the offline suite (the part CI actually runs without provider credentials) never exercises the rewritten credential-gating branches. That covers the partial user/password config error in checkUserAndPasswordProvider, the defined-but-blank token error in checkJustTokenProvider, the BitBucket API-token vs OAuth de-duplication in checkProvidersDefined, and the env-var-to-provider dispatch table in collectProviderBackupResults. The only offline tests are TestCheckProvidersFailureWhenNoneDefined (count==0) and TestGitHubEnvs (orgs without token). Every other path goes through live-provider tests that skip. I traced the new code by hand and it matches the old code, so nothing is broken today. But a copy error in these new helpers, such as a swapped provider func in the table or an inverted `foundCount` comparison, would still pass CI. These helpers are now small, pure functions that read env vars, so characterization tests are cheap.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a table-driven TestCheckProvider in internal/backup_test.go using t.Setenv plus unsetEnvVarsExcept([]string{envPath}). Cases: (a) AzureDevOps with only envAzureDevOpsUserName set returns (0, err containing "AzureDevOps parameter 'AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT' is not defined"), using the real env constant name; (b) AzureDevOps with both set returns (1, nil); (c) GitHub with envGitHubToken="  " returns (0, err containing "is not defined"); (d) GitHub token set returns (1, nil). Also add checkProvidersDefined cases where both BitBucket API-token and OAuth vars are set, and where only the OAuth vars are set; each should return nil.

residual_risks: The PR says 'log output unchanged' for displayStartupConfig, but no test captures logger output. I checked equivalence by hand only: the GitLab LFS line keeps the 'Gitlab' casing, the compare-method strings come from compareTypeRefs/compareTypeClone ('refs'/'clone'), and BitBucket's strings.ToLower(x)=="refs" became EqualFold, which is equivalent for an ASCII constant. Any future drift in this output will not be caught.

Run's scheduled paths (interval/cron through runScheduledJob, including the global `job` assignment that runProviderBackups later reads for NextRun) are only exercised by manual/live runs. No test covers the scheduler branches before or after this diff.
testing_gaps: backupStatusTitle (internal/notify.go:31) is a new pure function that sets the Telegram/ntfy/Slack titles, and it has no test. A 4-row table test would pin the three titles byte-for-byte, including the leading U+FE0F variation selectors I checked against main: (1,0)->succeeded, (1,1)->errors, (0,1)->failed, (0,0)->failed.

TestFailureIfGitBackupDirUndefined (internal/backup_test.go:819) uses require.Errorf with the message as a format string, so it passes on any error from Run. That includes logRequestTimeout or checkProvidersDefined failures that now come from separate helpers. It should assert require.ErrorContains(t, err, envGitBackupDir+" must be set") so the refactored validateStartupConfig path is the one actually proven.
